setup: Identical compiled candidate and synthetic 50k-product isolated D1 e4cbb0ef-6288-4fa1-9dbb-fb42fe01d4f3. Both use one compact fresh primary-D1 market-and-rights and full canonical book hydration SELECT. Flag off reads public market context from D1; flag on reads anonymous public market presentation from private R2 with strict live-market existence and currency fence in primary query. No production customer routing.

providerEvidence.source: Cloudflare Workers Observability trace samples correlated by exact traceId during isolated 100-RPS runs; raw SQL and identity payloads excluded.
providerEvidence.sqlObservation: Primary compact rights and hydration SQL completed in approximately 4 ms where successful; 7429 ten-second D1 resource-window overload remained in current authoritative read at 100 offered RPS, despite no separate market/context read.

interpretation: Both variants cleared 50 RPS sustained with 100% validity. The R2 projection reduced 100-RPS failures but did not meet any 100-RPS validity gate. The remaining primary D1 single-query read itself overloaded. No second 100-RPS phase, no four-geography production test, no production cutover. 50-RPS p95 was slightly slower with R2; no ungrounded latency claim.
decision: Further SQL-only or context-only tuning is insufficient. Next controlled experiment must separate current primary rights-only proof from full canonical book presentation/hydration via private R2, then test thin rights-only 50/100-RPS service limits before wiring book data. Read replicas without a current-primary bookmark cannot serve as authoritative current withdrawal checks.
